title: Pedagogical bilim beru facultinin okutuuchulary “Horizon Europe” conference synda

blocks.text: 2025-zhyldyn 16-mayynda өtkөn “Horizon Europe” el aralyk ilimiy conferenceson pedagogy zhana psychology departmentsyn bashchysy, p.i.k., associate professor Elzada Sabyrova zhana p.i.k. Salamat Moldalieva katyshty.

Conference Kyrgyzstan Europe Birimdiginin en iri ilimiy zhana innovationalik programs bolgon “Horizon Europe” programson koshuluu arkyluu el aralik kyzmattashtykka maaniluu kadam tashtagany belgilendi. Program 2021–2027-zhyldarga karata ishtelip chygyp, ilim, salamattyk saktoo, ecology, sanariptik technologylar, bilim beru syyaktuu tarmaktarga bagyttalgan.
Kyrgyzstan associationlangan mucho katars atalgan tarmaktardagy dolboorlorgo toluk kanduu katyshuu ukuguna ee bolup, universityter zhana ilimy mekemeler үchүn zhany mүmkүnchүlүktөrdү achuuda.

Bilim beruzhana or im ministerligin okulu Murzaliev K. “Horizon Europe” programs Kyrgyzstandyn ilimiy mumkunchuluktorun keneytip, Europe ilimiy ecosystemsyn integrationlanuuga shart tuzorun basa belgilady.
@ Elzada Sabyrova - Pedagogy Jean psychology department synyn bashchysy.
